name: Single Scattering Radiance and Gradient Estimation
definition:
Computes single scattering radiance $L_s$ at position $ oldsymbol{x}$ and its gradient $
abla L_s$ with respect to $ oldsymbol{x}$ by integrating over scene surfaces $A$, accounting for phase function $p$, reduced radiance $L_r$, visibility $V$, and geometry term $H$.
